verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that choosing 'Start voice chat' when the composer is empty lets you 'talk with the Bot live', which directly covers a real-time voice conversation with the assistant. The evidence is a single brief line, with no detail on conversational quality and no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: detail on latency, interruption/barge-in and conversational naturalness, which surfaces (desktop/mobile) support voice, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the voice experience.
